items.prompt: A grandmother's Soviet apartment: a black lacquered upright piano against patterned wallpaper, a round revolving piano stool in front of it, lace on top of the piano with a vase. Afternoon light from the side, the lacquer gleaming.

alt.ru: Бабушкина квартира: чёрное лакированное пианино у обоев с узором, перед ним круглый винтовой стул, на крышке салфетка и ваза.
alt.en: A grandmother's flat: a black lacquered upright piano against patterned wallpaper, a round revolving stool in front, a lace doily and vase on top.
alt.pt: O apartamento da avó: um piano vertical lacado a preto contra papel de parede padronizado, um banco giratório redondo, uma toalhinha e uma jarra em cima.
alt.es: El piso de la abuela: un piano vertical lacado en negro contra un papel pintado, un taburete giratorio redondo delante, un tapete de encaje y un jarrón encima.
